name: developmental red flags overview
title: Is a child's development on track: red flags in one domain (motor, speech and language, social) point to cerebral palsy, hearing loss or autism; two or more domains under 5 years is global developmental delay; loss of skills is a red flag at any age; every suspected delay is referred to early intervention

root.title: Is this child's development ON TRACK, or a RED FLAG?
lines: surveillance every visit (Rourke Baby Record) · screen higher-risk children: LookSee (Nipissing) or Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ)
ASQ grey zone → learning activities + monitor · black zone → further assessment · screens never diagnose
correct for prematurity until 24 months · a consistent trajectory over time matters most

groups.title: ONE domain behind
lines: speech and language predicts cognition MOST · gross motor LEAST

head: h
Motor
gross + fine
do: • examine tone and asymmetry: quality matters

head: h
Speech and language
do: • part of autism or a global delay

head: h
Social
flag: • poor eye contact, not engaging other children at 2 years
do: • echolalia can make language look better than it is

head: h
Global developmental delay
≤ 5 years · older: intellectual disability
do: 1 · History + physical: finds it in about 1 in 3
2 · Chromosomal microarray: FIRST-tier (also autism, intellectual disability)

rows: REFER to early intervention NOW, before any formal diagnosis
• as early as possible: brain plasticity
• hearing and vision: common and easily fixed
